known_limitations: The shared repository entrypoint validate_claim_evidence.py is currently a generic artifact-level wrapper, not a dedicated semantic cross-file validator. Producer-side semantic checks were executed with the committed JSON Schema and a local deterministic cross-file audit. The independent reviewer should decide whether a separately authorized versioned validator is required before acceptance.
WP-003 has not yet established the novelty boundary, so no first/novel claim is authorized.

Effect-size thresholds, powered sample size, final mode registry, and target table schemas remain outputs of later W0/W1 packages; the matrix binds identifiers and decision rules without inventing their future values.
All empirical result clauses remain placeholders. No pilot value is a confirmatory result.
unexpected_findings: A useful abstract contract requires separating technical scope/design sentences from the single primary empirical result; treating H1–H6 as co-primary abstract claims would create multiplicity and post-hoc flexibility.
Privacy-bounded portability cannot be retained as an abstract claim under the current evidence plan and was frozen as future work.
Cross-file audit detected and corrected placeholder-name drift before handoff.
